messages:
laura: Opened a docs PR updating the audit export playbookincluding a small CMK example and new retention phrasing. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4102. Need quick SOC2 wording + snippet sanity check before merge.

ben: Quick scan 0% top items: the CLI example uses `--export-scope tenant` which our CLI no longer accepts. The tool expects `--export-scope customer` (or `account`). Also avoid real IDs in examples.

ben: Proposed CLI (replace snippet):

```bash
redwoodctl export evidence --export-scope customer --customer-id cust-0001 --output ./evidence.jsonl \n  --from 2025-06-01 --to 2025-06-30 --kms-key arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/EXAMPLE
```

tamika: Legal note: avoid wording like "we delete after 120 days". Use neutral phrasing: "records are retained for up to 120 days unless a longer retention is required by contract or legal hold." Also add a one-line explainer that retention windows can vary by product tier.

legal-ops: Confirmed. Also add a short auditor checklist section: format (JSONL), fields that may contain PII (documented and redacted in examples), CMK note: "When exporting with a customer-managed key (CMK), ensure your KMS key policy permits decryption for export operations."

ben: The sample JSONL row currently contains `user.email`. Change to placeholders. Example row: `{"event_time":"2025-06-01T12:00:00Z","user_id":"cust-0001","action":"login","meta":"<redacted>"}`. Keep examples minimal.

laura: I'll swap `tenant` -> `customer`, update CLI flags, redact the JSONL examples, add the auditor checklist and CMK callout, and put the neutral retention phrasing. Anything else?

legal-ops: Add a Troubleshooting bullet for the common error `export: forbidden` recommending to verify `exporter` role binding and that the KMS key grants decrypt to the export principal. After those edits we can sign off.

docs-bot: CI build passed for PR #4102  Linter OK.

laura: Pushed changes and tagged @legal-ops.

legal-ops: Reviewed and approved. Merge when release checklist green.

laura: Merged. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
